reason: I already paid for a mass-DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so anything that sends DMs for me makes me flinch. There are no results from real users yet, and a refund after 300 DMs doesn't give me back the account health or the month I'd lose.
objection: No reviews or case studies, so how do I know it books calls? Sending 300 DMs to prove it is exactly what got me blocked last time, and saying 'human pace' isn't proof.
would_change_my_mind: Real booked-call numbers from a few named founding members who sell what I sell, or a short screen recording of someone's actual sends and replies from one account over a few weeks.
